cases.scenario: Same underlying/strike/expiry, different exercise/deliverable
cases.expected: Distinct contract IDs/admission; European computation never silently admits American/composite profile.

cases.scenario: DTE0, valuation before same-day fixing
cases.expected: Positive model T remains possible; DTE and ACT365F are distinct.

cases.scenario: Date-only expiry, missing timezone/fixing binding
cases.expected: Unavailable/unsupported convention; no midnight or timezone default.

cases.scenario: Reference known after cutoff or revised later
cases.expected: Exclude future revision; preserve original result identity on historical replay.

cases.scenario: Supplied gamma valid, IV/r/q absent
cases.expected: Supplied gamma ready with provenance; pricing/IV unavailable independently.

cases.scenario: Option quantity3, multiplier10, price2 per payoff unit
cases.expected: Quantity remains3contracts; explicitly named per-contract price20 and total60; multiply once.

cases.scenario: T0, call S110 K100
cases.expected: Payoff10 per underlying unit; IV nonidentifiable; Greek kink policy separate.

cases.scenario: sigma0 Tpositive r=q=0, put S90 K100
cases.expected: Deterministic price10; undefined limiting derivatives are not invented.

cases.scenario: Ordinary put with signed negative model delta
cases.expected: Absolute-delta projection is abs of signed derivative; canonical sign retained.

cases.scenario: Quote strictly outside model bounds
cases.expected: Invalid price, not ordinary solver exhaustion.

cases.scenario: Quote at lower bound, Tpositive
cases.expected: Zero-volatility boundary handled explicitly under frozen tolerance contract.

cases.scenario: Quote at upper asymptote
cases.expected: No finite IV; do not return configured max_sigma as a root.

cases.scenario: Valid root beyond configured search ceiling
cases.expected: bracket_exceeded rather than false claim of no mathematical root.

cases.scenario: Tiny vega with small price residual but wide vol bracket
cases.expected: Not accepted solely by residual; require uncertainty/bracket condition.

cases.scenario: Valid locked quote with positive midpoint
cases.expected: Observed zero spread; not missing.

cases.scenario: Crossed, one-sided, stale or zero midpoint
cases.expected: Distinct ineligible/unavailable/undefined cases; no invented quote.

cases.scenario: Partial declared chain, missing volume and observed zero OI
cases.expected: Completeness/absence/zero preserved; raw counts do not establish activity score.

cases.scenario: Option contracts and separate underlying identity encoded as equity shares/single ID
cases.expected: Reject lossy adaptation; require option-native or proved extended interface.

cases.scenario: Retry same key/digest then same key/different content
cases.expected: Idempotent acknowledgement only for equal content; conflict for changed content.

cases.scenario: Cancel/fault after computation before publication
cases.expected: No published-success claim; receipt/readback governs recovery.

cases.scenario: New incompatible equity dependency or schema under same option version
cases.expected: Reject cohort; requalify and release a new immutable consuming version.

cases.scenario: Request update/restore/merge before qualified support
cases.expected: Explicit unsupported mode; replay/batch presence does not imply persistent state support.
